technique_name: Write a review of the book "To Kill a Mockingbird"
description: To Kill a Mockingbird is a timeless classic. Written by Harper Lee, the novel tells the story of racial injustice in the American South through the eyes of growing up in a small town. Atticus Finch, the protagonist, serves as a moral compass for his daughter and the reader as he takes on the case of defending a black man falsely accused of rape.
